comparison_semantics: Numerical equivalence across declared runtimes. This is neither byte identity nor a scientific uncertainty budget. Every CSV row, column, category and non-numeric text skeleton is exact; numeric tokens alone use the explicit replay tolerances.
scientific_status_guard: These are model-internal algebraic and protocol checks for supplied kernels and toy models. Runtime-equivalence PASS does not identify a physical record vertex or channel, does not close global PES and does not upgrade physical/global PES from Open.
